author: Terrell Boettcher
title: Canes softball finishes season at Merrill - NewsBreak
text:
By Terrell Boettcher ,
22 hours ago The Hayward Hurricanes softball team finished their season with a 0-2 loss to the Merrill Bluejays at the regional semifinal playoff in Merrill Wednesday May 27.
Merrill pitcher McKenzie Hurt pitched a no-hitter while striking out 20 Hayward batters. Hurt also had a solo home run in the first inning, giving the home team a 1-0 lead.
The Bluejays added a run in the sixth inning on a double and a squeeze bunt allowing a runner on third base to steal home. They finished with five hits in the game.
Kaydee Campbell started on the mound for Hayward and pitched three innings, giving up three hits and one run while walking two. Alli Coddington pitched the last three innings, giving up two hits and striking out one.
The Hurricanes finished their season with a 12-10 record.
Merrill advanced to the regional championship against Medford on May 28, where they lost to the host Raiders, 6-8.
